title: Scalar-compatible comparison of the extended first residue ideal
statement: For prime l, finite extension E of Q_l and any scheme X, there exists a ring-sheaf isomorphism beta from the continuous integral section ring on the coefficient-sized small pro-etale model site to ConstantCompletion.completed for the lifted integer ring and lifted uniformizer ideal. For every site object, the extension along the actual scalarMap of the kernel of the actual discrete residueMap equals the comap along beta of the first completed projection kernel. These maps and coefficient rings are those of [def-sfb-integral-models-stacks-data] and [det-prop-integral-criterion-constant-coefficients].

proof.text: Reconstruct the discrete constant ring isomorphism from the monoidal point-constant comparison and pull it to X. Its naturality identifies the specified discrete residue homomorphism.

The compact-adic continuous-function comparison gives an isomorphism from continuous integral sections to the finite-quotient limit. Its scalar square commutes: the sheafification adjunction identifies its constant-function map with the specified scalarMap. The DVR, profinite tower, and coset basis supply all hypotheses.

Pass through the AsSmall constant and completion comparisons, using naturality and finite-projection formulas. Descend ULift.down through the first quotient. This gives scalar and residue squares. The flat_and_quotients section formula makes the completed kernel the span of scalar images of discrete-kernel elements. Pull this span back through the comparison isomorphism and apply the local-span characterization of ideal extension.

lean.statement:
theorem integralModels_residueIdealComparison (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) :
    ∃ β : (Arrow.mk (smallMap X (scalarMap l E X))).right ≅
        ConstantCompletion.completed (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, u} X)
          (IntegralConstantCompletion.integers l E) (IntegralConstantCompletion.ideal l E),
      ∀ U : Scheme.coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, u} X,
        ((ConstantCompletion.kernelIdeal (smallMap X (residueMap l E X))).extension
          (smallMap X (scalarMap l E X))).sections U =
        Ideal.comap (β.hom.hom.app (op U)).hom
          ((ConstantCompletion.kernelIdeal (ConstantCompletion.projection
            (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, u} X)
            (IntegralConstantCompletion.integers l E)
            (IntegralConstantCompletion.ideal l E) 0)).sections U)
